Evelyn / Karthik — forwarding HarborBank's note and the auditor summary. The key asks: a) management response confirming the plan for the two exceptions, b) draft bridge letter they can share with their auditor, and c) initial evidence we can hand off this week if possible.

Quick context: the findings reference a gap in documented change approval for a hotfix (Change Management) and an overly broad read ACL on a monitoring S3 bucket (Logical Access). We already implemented the hotfix workflow change in July (ticket RED-3421) and put an ACL remediation in place last week (s3:restrict-read-logs). The customer wants artifacts to show the mitigations are in place and a short timeline for closure.

Could one of you:
- Draft a 1-paragraph management response for each finding (status, actions taken, remediation ETA).
- Assemble any immediate artifacts (ticket numbers, config diffs, screenshots).
- Put together a bridge letter template we can sign (I can coordinate legal if needed).

Target: I told them we'd aim to send the draft bridge letter + remediation matrix by Friday COB (2026-09-03). If that's unrealistic, flag me ASAP so I can reset expectations.

Jordan / Karthik — taking point on the management responses and artifacts. See inline below for proposed language; attaching a remediation matrix (remediation_matrix_v1.xlsx) and a first-pass bridge letter (bridge_letter_draft.docx) in the Drive link.

Proposed management responses (short form):
1) Change Management — Finding: missing documented approval for a hotfix deployed 2026-07-12. Management response: Redwood confirms the hotfix was applied to address an urgent stability issue. We have updated the Change Management procedure to require post-deployment approval within 48 hours for emergency changes (policy update v2.3, effective 2026-07-20). Evidence: ticket RED-3421 (URL included in matrix), deployment audit snapshot (audit id DEP-20260712), and the updated change policy. Remediation ETA: Completed (control updated and backfilled approvals).

2) Logical Access — Finding: excessive read permission on monitoring log bucket. Management response: Redwood restricted read permissions to the monitoring bucket to the logging service principal and SOC team on 2026-08-25, removed broad group read assignment, and initiated a quarterly access review process. Evidence: IAM policy diff (included), S3 ACL change record (S3-ACL-20260825), and access review schedule. Remediation ETA: Controls implemented (evidence attached); quarterly review in first week of each quarter.

Attachments we can deliver this week: remediation_matrix_v1.xlsx (ticket refs, artifacts, timestamps), bridge_letter_draft.docx (legal to review), audit evidence screenshots (to be zipped). I recommend we:
- Send the draft bridge letter + remediation matrix to HarborBank on Thu morning so they have time to circulate before their procurement meeting.
- Provide the raw evidence files via secure Drive link and prepare a DocuSign if they need a signed bridge.

If Legal wants wording changes on the bridge, I can incorporate — please loop them if necessary.

Evelyn
